Ibrahim: Quick kickoff — OnRamp Terraform starter for Cloud Partner Q. Target: publish reference-arch + minimal Terraform modules + CI smoke examples by May 15. Repo skeleton link will be shared.
Keiko: Narrow scope to GKE first (partner pilot). Modules: network, k8s_cluster, node_pool, ingress, kms. Keep IAM surfaces minimal.
Zoe: I'll own partner README, onboarding checklist, and two example var files (prod and dev-slim). ETA May 6.
Marco: I'll scaffold TF modules and include stable outputs: cluster_name, kubeconfig_secret, node_pool_ids. PR for initial modules by May 4.
Ibrahim: Need a marketplace metadata stub (short blurb + 2 screenshots) and a 20s deploy gif. Who can help with screenshots?
Zoe: I can do screenshots and a short gif. Will add to assets/ and write alt text for accessibility.
Marco: CI plan: GH Actions with validation/plan job and gated apply to sandbox. Include terraform fmt, validate, and pinned provider versions.
BuildBot: Ticket created: PART-Q-4521 (labels: partner, iaac, marketplace).
Keiko: Add a hardware-compatibility appendix (Graviton/Ampere notes) marked experimental. We'll link partner perf docs instead of deep benchmarking.
Ibrahim: Action items recap:
 - Marco: TF modules + examples (due May 4)
 - Zoe: README + marketplace assets (due May 6)
 - Keiko: ref-arch diagram + partner checklist (due May 3)
 - Ibrahim: open repo and create issue tracker (today)
Marco: We'll include examples/deploy.sh and a minimal `examples/README.md` with copy-paste snippets.
Zoe: Will draft marketplace blurb and screenshots this week.
Ibrahim: Let's keep module outputs stable across minor releases and add a changelog + semver policy. Next sync after initial PRs. :rocket:
